name: Cloudflare Remote MCP Server Template
description: A template for deploying remote Model Context Protocol servers to Cloudflare Workers without authentication. It enables hosting custom tools via Server-Sent Events for integration with clients like Claude Desktop and the Cloudflare AI Playground.
